evidence_quotes: Artikel 23, eerste lid, van de Elektriciteitswet 1998
rationale: This Dutch CBb decision concerns a dispute resolution decision under Article 23(1) and Article 1(6) of the Electricity Act 1998 (Elektriciteitswet 1998) regarding the obligation to provide an electricity grid connection (aansluitplicht) for wind turbines in a wind farm (windpark). Under the coding protocol, electricity network aansluitplicht disputes are explicitly classified as NOT_WATER and not_water_related.
